artist_notes.name: Dave Aju
artist_notes.note: SF producer (Marc Barrite) on Circus Company: soulful, left-field house built from his own vocals and samples; has played Fabric and Panorama Bar.

artist_notes.name: Masha Mar
artist_notes.note: LA DJ/curator from the Midnight Lovers crew with NTS and Dublab residencies: Italo, house and dancefloor edits.

curator_note: Dave Aju and Masha Mar on the same bill is the pull, and an all-day-into-4am format gives it room to stretch. Venue is still TBA, so don't commit until it drops.
description: Album release party for Navid Izadi's Ayande from Rhonda Intl and In Between, a six-act house and disco bill running 10am to 4am at a TBA location; free with RSVP before 11pm.

artist_notes.name: Heidi Lawden
artist_notes.note: LA-via-London selector out of the '90s UK queer rave scene: long house/techno/disco sets and a longtime DJ Harvey tour collaborator.

artist_notes.name: Flabbergast (LA)
artist_notes.note: LA techno DJ and founder of VICE Underground: heavy, acid-leaning drums.

curator_note: Heidi Lawden's marathon-style sets plus the VICE Underground crowd point to a proper late room. Location is TBA and Tom Peters is unknown to me, so wait for the address.
description: Late-night Extra Sensory x Vice party, 11pm to 6am, with Tom Peters, Heidi Lawden and Flabbergast; venue TBA.

curator_note: A secret-location DTLA night leaning minimal and trance-tinged techno, which is a different texture from the usual four-on-the-floor. I don't know the three names, so this is a gamble on the promoter and the room.
description: Information is a secret-location DTLA party, 10pm to 5am, with Shakolin, 98dots and Kana Hishiya playing trance, minimal and techno.

curator_note: No lineup and no venue yet, just a name and a Lincoln Heights pin. Keep an eye on it but don't plan around it.
description: Late-night house party at a TBA Lincoln Heights location on Fri 11/13 from 10pm; no lineup announced.

artist_notes.name: Arlo Parks
artist_notes.note: London singer-songwriter (indie/alt-R&B, Mercury Prize winner); unusual to see her billed on a club night, so format of her slot is unconfirmed.

curator_note: Arlo Parks on a Rhonda bill is a surprise booking, but I can't tell if it's a DJ set or something else. Check the format before treating it as a dance night.
description: A Club Called Rhonda at Los Globos with Arlo Parks, DRAMA, Gabriels and more, starting 9:30pm.

artist_notes.name: Neil Frances
artist_notes.note: Pop/indie-dance duo; listing tags the night pop, disco, house and funk, so expect crossover rather than a club-head set.

curator_note: Halloween night at Sound with a poppier disco-house crossover act. Fun but not a diggers' night, and $47 is steep for it.
description: Neil Frances at Sound Nightclub in Hollywood, 10pm to 3am, billed as pop, disco, house and funk.

curator_note: Straight tech-house Halloween with a Stoley b2b Kaveh set as the hook. It's a decent fit if you want that sound on the Westside, though venue is still TBA.
description: Groove Factory x ClubView Records Halloween party with Naar, Stoley b2b Kaveh, Sosh & Mosh and Krow at a TBA Santa Monica spot; from 9pm, $25+.

curator_note: A Dia de los Muertos late-night from the Por Detroit crew, with Perfect Lovers on the bill. Genre and venue are both unconfirmed, so it's a night-of decision.
description: Halloween/Day of the Dead electronic night at a TBA LA location from 11pm with PAURRO, sam blake, Perfect Lovers and Victor Rodriguez.

curator_note: Downtempo and dub techno from the Tenhouse crew, free with RSVP. It's a lower-key, headphone-style room if you want something that isn't peak-hour.
description: Physical, a free-with-RSVP downtempo and dub techno night from Tenhouse at a TBA DTLA venue, 9pm to 3am.
